targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry_main")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "60")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "Ignition_Array" or r._field == "Ignition_Motor" or r._field == "Ignition_Off" or r._field == "Cruise_Enable" or r._field == "Cruise_Set" or r._field == "Gear_Forward" or r._field == "Gear_Neutral" or r._field == "Gear_Reverse" or r._field == "Hazard_Pressed" or r._field == "Horn_Pressed" or r._field == "Blinker_Left" or r._field == "Blinker_Right" or r._field == "PushToTalk_Pressed" or r._field == "Regen_Activate" or r._field == "Regen_Enable")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vehicle == "HighNoon")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
